attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: অন্য জীবের ওপর থেকেই খাদ্য নেয়, বিনিময়ে উপকার করে না।

definition.oewn_definition: an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host
definition.text: an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host

examples.en: The parasite weakened the young plant.

bangla_explanation.text: অন্যের ওপর নির্ভর করে সুবিধা নেয়, নিজে কিছু দেয় না।

definition.oewn_definition: a follower who hangs around a host (without benefit to the host) in hope of gain or advantage
definition.text: a follower who hangs around a host (without benefit to the host) in hope of gain or advantage

examples.bn: সে মামার সংসারের পরজীবী হয়ে উঠল।
examples.en: He became a parasite in his uncle's household.
